projects.title: TraceSafe v2.0
projects.description: A civic-tech platform enabling citizens, government officials, and administrators to coordinate missing person reports and findings. Built with role-based access, real-time dashboards, and secure data pipelines.
projects.longDescription: TraceSafe v2.0 features three distinct user roles — normal citizens who report and flag findings, government officials who coordinate case responses, and administrators who oversee the entire ecosystem. Each role gets a custom dashboard tailored to their workflow. This is the successor to TraceSafe v1.0 which was Web3-integrated.

projects.title: This Portfolio
projects.description: A vintage-glitch aesthetic developer portfolio blending retro VHS nostalgia with neon cyberpunk energy. Built with React, featuring a custom design system, boot sequence animation, and glitch effects.
projects.longDescription: The very site you're browsing right now. Designed from scratch with a custom retro-futuristic design language — Press Start 2P typography, neon glow effects, CRT scanlines, VHS tracking noise, and Framer Motion animations. Meta enough to be listed as its own project.

projects.title: RestoBill
projects.description: A Python-powered desktop billing system for restaurants. Handles order marking, real-time stock tracking, bill printing & emailing, manager/cashier role logins, MRP/tax management, and audit log exports compatible with PowerBI.
projects.longDescription: RestoBill streamlines restaurant operations with a dual-role system — cashiers mark orders and generate bills (print or email), while managers restock inventory, update pricing and tax rates, and export detailed audit logs. The real-time stock engine automatically deducts items as they're ordered and flags low-stock warnings.

projects.title: School Website
projects.description: A professional website developed for a school client. Features a clean academic aesthetic with admissions info, faculty profiles, events calendar, notice board, and a gallery — all content-managed and mobile-responsive.
projects.longDescription: Built as a freelance project for a school institution. Delivered a fast, accessible, and SEO-friendly web presence that gives parents, students, and staff easy access to information. Mobile-first design with responsive layouts across all screen sizes.

projects.title: Travel Tour Website
projects.description: A travel and tourism website built for a tour operator client. Showcases tour packages, destinations, itineraries, and pricing with an inquiry/booking form and a visual gallery of travel destinations.
projects.longDescription: Developed as a freelance project, this site gives the tour operator a professional digital presence to attract and convert travelers. Features destination browsing, package listings with itineraries, contact and inquiry forms, and a rich image gallery. Optimized for local SEO to help the client get discovered.

projects.title: TraceSafe v1.0
projects.description: The original TraceSafe — a blockchain-integrated platform for missing person reporting using decentralized identity verification. Built with Web3 smart contracts to ensure tamper-proof case records.
projects.longDescription: TraceSafe v1.0 was an ambitious experiment integrating Web3 technology into civic-tech. Smart contracts on Ethereum handled immutable case records and decentralized identity. The platform proved the concept but faced scalability and maintenance challenges that led to the full v2.0 rebuild.

projects.title: FreelanceIT
projects.description: A decentralized freelancing marketplace where freelancers and recruiters collaborate on projects with trustless escrow-based payments. Disputes auto-escalate to admin intervention, ensuring fairness for both parties.
projects.longDescription: FreelanceIT used Ethereum smart contracts to hold payments in escrow, only releasing funds upon project milestone completion and mutual agreement. A built-in dispute resolution system auto-escalated unresolved conflicts to a trusted admin panel. The platform aimed to eliminate middlemen and payment fraud from freelancing.
